environment.description: Same Actix-web binary packaged as a container image deployed to AWS Lambda with a Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda execution role has a resource-based policy that only grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl to principals within the same AWS Organization (condition: aws:PrincipalOrgID). The function URL endpoint returns HTTP 403 with '{"Message":"Forbidden"}' for any request that does not include a valid SigV4 signature from an authorized IAM principal. Note: the race condition in the shutdown handler still exists in the code, and the path traversal in /archive is still present - the Lambda runtime does process requests that pass IAM auth. The ADMIN_TOKEN is set via Lambda environment variable encrypted with a KMS key (aws/lambda default). Internal service-to-service calls use IAM roles with lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission scoped to this specific function ARN.

config.runtime: AWS Lambda container image, x86_64, 512MB memory
config.resource_policy: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl allowed only for aws:PrincipalOrgID = o-abc123def4
config.network: Lambda VPC with no public subnet attachment, egress only via NAT
config.note: Function URL returns 403 for unsigned requests; SigV4 required with valid org credentials
